about_the_game:
🎮 Game Overview

In this story-driven romance simulation, you’ll play as Broken — a rich girl who struck oil in her own backyard and stumbled into sudden wealth, only to be sent to a prestigious Finance Academy after spectacular investment failures and a complete meltdown of her money sense.

Your mission?
Simple enough: learn how to invest, avoid bankruptcy, and maybe—just maybe—fall in love with one of the academy’s eccentric (and dangerously unstable) high-profile bachelors.

Meet the cast:

💰 Broken (Protagonist)

“Make Oil Baby great again!”
Our heroine. A girl who once dug up oil in her backyard, skyrocketed to wealth, and spiraled into disastrous financial choices. Now forced into the Academy to learn how not to burn through family fortunes. Her story lies somewhere between financial freedom and complete delusion (or maybe that’s just the smell of oil).

Oil Baby was the cosmetics brand she founded, aimed at high-income customers.

Built with the highest standards—even the bottle caps were made of gold. And well… now you know the reason she went bankrupt.

Manil

VA:梅こぶし

“Hmm? What’s with that dazed look, dear student?”
A refined linguistics teacher and fund CEO. Mature, eloquent, endlessly charismatic… and sometimes oddly unpredictable. He has such commanding presence that you’d swear he’s the headmaster (spoiler: he’s not).

Karlsai

VA:七草秋人

“W-Woman! Why are you staring at me? Don’t tell me… you’ve fallen in love with me!?”
The son of a real estate tycoon. Calls himself “ore-sama,” max-level tsundere, and utterly hopeless around women. To him, Broken is his first female friend—if you don’t count his mom and maids (which he insists you shouldn’t).

Lancelot

VA:楠木まれ

“My lady, if you don’t spend this million, don’t bother going home.”
The Academy’s founder and current headmaster. The ultimate domineering CEO type. Obsessed with building muscle—especially pecs—he’s infamous for teaching in a naked apron and punishing wrong answers with his “muscular wrath.” Rumors say he and his sister (who runs a language school) are secretly the “twin pillars of the market.”

📚 Game Details
Playtime: ~1.5–2 hours

Genre: Visual Novel

World: Shared universe with Doki Boki Hentai Language School (yes, it’s all connected!)

✨ Features
💼 Romance × Finance × Pure Chaos — Who knew investment theory could be this… alluring?

💪 The Button Attack is Real — Yes, the headmaster uses his shirt buttons as weapons.

📉 Choices Matter — Every decision could lead you to love… or total bankruptcy.

🛢️ “Did oil make me fall in love with you, or are you more valuable than oil?”

content_descriptors.notes:
Mild foul words,
Mild sexual harassment,
Revealing clothing
